name: zyanya-webmcp
description: Zyanya GhostDAG L1 Agentic Tool Protocol for autonomous node queries, mining diagnostics, and DAG state retrieval.

tools.name: zyanya_get_dag_info
tools.description: Returns real-time GhostDAG metrics including block count, tip hashes, virtual difficulty, and DAA score.

tools.name: zyanya_get_node_info
tools.description: Returns node health, daemon version, connection counts, and sync status.

tools.name: zyanya_get_balance
tools.description: Queries confirmed and unconfirmed balance (in sompi and ZYAN) for any valid Zyanya address.

address.description: Zyanya Bech32 address (e.g., zyanya:q... or zyanyatest:q...).

tools.name: zyanya_get_utxos
tools.description: Fetches unspent transaction outputs (UTXOs) with sompi amounts, script public keys, and DAA scores.

addresses.description: List of Bech32 addresses to query.

tools.name: zyanya_check_ipv6_pinhole
tools.description: Executes an IPv6 GhostDAG mesh connectivity test to canonical seeds and returns pinhole diagnostics.

tools.name: zyanya_estimate_mining_target
tools.description: Calculates the current AstroBWTv3 mining difficulty target and estimated block time.

hashrate_khs.description: Optional miner hashrate in KH/s to estimate expected reward times.
